name: The Witch Doctor's Head
summary: Archmage Lan'dalock asks you to kill the Sandfury witch doctor Zum'rah in Zul'Farrak and bring back his intact head. The request rests on a history Lan'dalock shares with the troll.

sections.title: Lan'dalock's Request
sections.body: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants Zum'rah dead. The witch doctor is inside Zul'Farrak, a Sandfury stronghold deep in Tanaris. Lan'dalock says he has history with Zum'rah, and asks you to return with the troll's head intact. His request turns on that old grievance.

faq.answer: Zum'rah is a troll witch doctor inside Zul'Farrak, the Sandfury stronghold in Tanaris.
Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran asks you to kill Zum'rah. He says he has history with the troll.
Zum'rah is inside Zul'Farrak, deep in the deserts of Tanaris.

faq.q: Why does Lan'dalock want him killed?
aliases: why does archmage want zumrah dead
faq.answer: Lan'dalock says he has history with Zum'rah, but gives no further detail.

faq.q: What does Lan'dalock ask you to bring back?
faq.answer: Lan'dalock asks you to bring him Zum'rah's head intact.
